[0 to 2s] A young warrior in battle-worn leather and steel armor sprints across a crumbling stone bridge suspended over a misty chasm, sword drawn, cloak whipping behind him. The camera tracks alongside him at a low angle, moving fast to match his sprint. Storm clouds swirl overhead, lit by flashes of distant lightning.

[2 to 4s] A massive dragon erupts from the mist below, wings snapping open as it lunges toward the bridge, jaws wide, embers scattering from its throat. The warrior leaps sideways, rolling across the stone as debris explodes from the bridge where the dragon's claws strike. Camera whip-pans to follow the leap, then snaps into a fast push-in on the warrior's face mid-roll.

[4 to 5s] The warrior rises in one motion, plants his feet, and swings his sword upward in a wide arc as the dragon's roar shakes the screen. Final frame holds on the blade catching a flash of lightning.

Sound: rolling thunder, dragon roar, clashing metal, wind gusting hard, distant rock crumbling.

Live-action, photorealistic, cinematic film footage — not animation, not CGI-stylized, not cartoon.

[0 to 2s] A woman stands in a sunlit doorway, seen from behind in a medium shot showing her head, shoulders, and upper back. Wind gently moves her hair and the fabric of her jacket. Soft natural daylight, shallow depth of field, static camera at chest height.

[2 to 5s] She slowly turns to face the camera, the medium shot now showing her head and shoulders clearly — late 20s, soft natural features, warm brown eyes catching the daylight, calm and confident expression. Natural skin texture, realistic light and shadow across her face, background softly blurred behind her. Camera holds steady, framing her from mid-chest up.

Sound: soft ambient wind, distant birdsong — no music, no dialogue.
HD video, high quality, sharp details, smooth motion
